cues.text: Alaska just won a rare earth
award, and it came with no rare earths.

coal waste with a microbe, Shewanella oneidensis.

is not biology, it is software.

a plant built from measurements.

on a power budget.
That copy is the only tank,
because the award funds a virtual pilot plant.
Work starts September first, so
no result exists yet.
PubMed indexes four papers pairing
this microbe with rare earths.

That abstract names the University
of Wyoming a full partner, and gives it nothing.
Run that on Alaska, one operating
coal mine and no named source
for the waste.

The abstract makes the power limit
the core problem, not a footnote.

timing and power.
